title: Personal Support Worker Retirement Savings Innovation Program – Call for Concepts – Step 1
body: To apply by email or mail, download and complete the application form.
Email your application to edsc.pssp-psw.esdc@hrsdc-rhdcc.gc.ca by 3:00 pm Eastern Standard Time on January 24, 2025.
You will receive a confirmation of receipt by email within 48 hours.
Your application must be postmarked on or before 3:00 pm Eastern Standard Time on January 24, 2025. Your application should be mailed to the address below.
If you submit your application by mail, you will receive an acknowledgment by email within 14 days of its receipt. The acknowledgment will be sent to the email address provided in your application.
If you do not use the recommended readers (Adobe Acrobat 8 or higher or Foxit Reader), ESDC may receive a blank application from you.
To move from one field to the next on the form, hit “Tab”. This ensures that you do not accidently skip over any fields.

Some sections of the form perform calculations based on the amounts you enter and will automatically calculate totals in the appropriate fields. You are responsible for the completeness and accuracy of any information submitted. Please double-check all data you enter.
Submit only 1 copy of your application to ESDC.

We expect to make decisions for step 1 in winter 2025. If you are successful in step 1 of this process, we will invite you to step 2 to develop a full project proposal. We expect that projects will start as early as January 2026.
